create_HelloRobotMover: create a HelloRobotMover instance connected to a robot by its IP address
move_absolute_HelloRobotMover: move the robot to an absolute position in canonical world coordinates
look_at_HelloRobotMover: command the robot to look at a target by adjusting camera pan and tilt
get_rgb_depth_HelloRobotMover: fetch RGB, depth, and point cloud data from the robot camera
get_obstacles_HelloRobotMover: get obstacle positions in canonical coordinates from the robot SLAM map
